title: QCLI-208's AC#7/AC#8 are corrupted phantom criteria (literal '5') and need repair
description:
QCLI-208 ('Adopt opum-agent shared skill source and deliver ODOC-71.8 read-only Quest task-binding adapter') is Done with 6 genuine, correctly-checked acceptance criteria (#1-#6). AC#7 and AC#8 carry no real content -- both read literally as the digit '5'. This is a record-integrity repair, not reopened work: the six substantive criteria are satisfied and this task should stay Done throughout.

Root cause confirmed, not guessed: reproduced against both the pinned Backlog.md 1.50.1 and the current 1.51.0 (npx). 'task edit --ac <value>' and 'task edit --check-ac <index>' are separate flags with opposite effects -- --ac appends a new unchecked criterion with the given text; --check-ac checks an existing one by index. Running '--ac 5' when '--check-ac 5' was intended appends a phantom criterion whose text is literally '5', silently, with no warning. Reported upstream: https://github.com/MrLesk/Backlog.md/issues/1000 (report only, no fix/PR offered, per standing instruction).

git history on the pre-migration Backlog source (git show 5c174e8^:'backlog/tasks/qcli-97.5.1 - Adopt-opum-agent-shared-skill-source-and-deliver-ODOC-71.8-read-only-Quest-task-binding-adapter.md') shows this happened twice, in commits 133d31d (2026-08-24 12:46, added #7) and 642be1e (2026-08-24 13:03, added #8) -- both are 'edit --status Done' re-finalization passes. In both diffs, AC#1-#6 were already all checked before the edit, so the plausible lost intent both times was 'reaffirm AC#5 is checked' (--check-ac 5), which was already true and would have been a harmless no-op. There is no evidence either phantom entry represents a distinct, real criterion that was dropped.

Given that, the likely-correct repair is removal (--remove-ac), not fabricated replacement text -- but this task exists so whoever picks it up can independently judge that against the linked PR/commit context (133d31d, 642be1e) rather than take this analysis on faith.

acceptanceCriteria.text: AC#7 and AC#8 on QCLI-208 are resolved -- either removed as corrupted phantom entries, or replaced with real text if the original intent is recoverable from PR/commit context beyond what this task cites
QCLI-208 stays Done throughout; this is not reopened work
The task record notes the resolution and cites this task and the upstream report
